About this item

  • High-speed Performance: Designed for casual gamers and everyday use, this external SSD with up to 1050MB/s accelerates large file transfers, media editing, and backup processes outperforming traditional hard drives
  • Built to Last: Perfect for travel and all types of weather with IP55 water and dust resistance. Plus, it's drop resistant up to 7.5 ft (2 meters). This portable drive is designed for durability and reliability wherever you go
  • Broad Compatibility: External drive connects effortlessly with Windows, Mac, iPad Pro, Chromebooks, Android, Linux, PS4, PS5, and Xbox via USB-C and USB-A for easy and fast file transfers
  • High-Capacity Storage: Store all your photos, videos, backups, and more with this compact 2TB SSD. It's perfect for students, everyday users, and anyone needing secure and reliable storage for their files
  • Bonus Software Included: Enjoy three months of Mylio Photos plus and Acronis True Image when you purchase and register your external drive

Product Description

The Crucial X9 2TB Portable SSD (CT2000X9SSD902) provides high-performance storage with read speeds of up to 1050MB/s, allowing for quick and efficient transfers of large files, including high-resolution photos, 4K videos, and gaming data. With its 2TB storage capacity, this external SSD is perfect for professionals, content creators, and gamers who need ample storage for their growing digital libraries. Built for portability and durability, the Crucial X9 is compact and lightweight, making it easy to carry wherever you go. Its IP55-rated water and dust resistance and drop protection from up to 7.5 feet ensure that your data remains safe in even the toughest conditions, whether you're traveling, working outdoors, or in harsh environments. The Crucial X9 is compatible with a wide range of devices, including PC, Mac, Android, and more, making it easy to transfer files across multiple platforms using USB-C connectivity. This combination of speed, capacity, and ruggedness makes the Crucial X9 2TB Portable SSD an excellent choice for users who need fast, reliable storage that can handle the demands of professional use and travel.

    How customer reviews and ratings work

    Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

    To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

    Customers say

    Customers find the portable SSD performs well and appreciate its compact size that makes it easy to carry around. The drive offers plenty of storage capacity and is super easy to plug and play. However, the speed receives mixed feedback, with some reporting great transfer rates while others find it slow. Moreover, reliability is a concern as multiple customers report it failing within 2 days or not lasting more than 5 months. Additionally, connectivity compatibility varies, with it working well with MacBooks but not with iPhones or Xbox Series X. Value for money opinions are divided between those who find it well worth the money and those who consider it overpriced.
